blurb: Guests join Captain Ross and First Mate Jayden for fishing charters in Cape Cod Bay, Buzzards Bay, Nantucket Sound, Vineyard Sound, Provincetown area, Woods Hole, and the Atlantic Ocean. Trips target species like Striped Bass, Bluefish, Black Sea Bass, Bluefin Tuna, Tautog, Atlantic Bonito, False Albacore, and Scup. Meeting points are at 110 Scranton Ave, Falmouth, MA and Taylor Point Marina, Buzzards Bay, MA.
